answer: Proof of Stake utilizes a capital-intensive ledge to ensure node validity, preventing a hollow network of phantom agents. By requiring participants to lock collateral, the cost to scale Sybil attacks scales linearly with asset ownership, making the acquisition of fake identities prohibitively expensive. Even if an attacker attempts to paint a saffron hue of legitimacy over malicious clusters, they cannot bypass the economic barriers that dictate influence proportional to verified, staked stake.
